title: Hurricane Hunters Fly Michael
description: Members of the 53rd Weather Reconnaissance Squadron flew into the eye of Hurricane Michael as it made landfall, Oct. 10, 2018. The Hurricane Hunters gather data from tropical cyclones, which is provided to the National Hurricane Center to assist in narrowing the path of the storm. (U.S. Air Force video by Lt. Col. Sean Cross) (Video footage speed increased and music added.)
